The '''Norat system''' was located in the [[Farlax sector/Legends|Farlax sector]], a part of [[the Negs]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with both the group known as the [[Norat]]<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> and the [[Norat Sovereignty]] government.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|389|Norat Sovereignty}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Norat [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square K-10.<ref name="TEA" />
